01 · Brand Identity

We carve meaning into design.

Carving Dezine’s identity is built on one idea: a speech bubble that carves a “d” out of silence. This section holds the strategy, the logo family, the rules for using it and how it shows up in the world. Every text block marked ✎ editable can be changed in place and is saved in your browser.

We carve meaning into design

One practice, from the first brief to the finished brand.

Positioning

Who we are and why it matters

Positioning

Carving Dezine carries an idea all the way from design with meaning, so that what is imagined is exactly what gets made.

Vision

A world where good design stops people in their tracks, and then gets them to act.

Mission

To bring design and delivery together under one roof and turn concepts into production-ready products with clarity, craft and accountability.

Draft copy for the studio. Edit it to match your own language; changes persist locally.

Brand pillars

Four stages, one practice

Every project moves through the same four stages. Each one is led by Tanvi Shah, so nothing gets lost between them.

    Who we design for

    Founders & product teams

    Turning a validated concept into something buildable, without losing the design intent on the way.

    Established brands

    Marketing & sales teams

    Presentations, print and campaigns that are consistent, on time and easy to approve.

    Logo family

    Two logos, one symbol, one email version

    Pick the variant by background. All files are the latest artwork supplied by Carving Dezine, embedded in this document and downloadable.

    Background tester

    Choose a background, get the right logo

    The recommendation is calculated from the background's luminance and the measured contrast of each variant.

    Background
    Custom colour
    Vector mark

    Recolourable symbol

    The mark rebuilt as eight polygons on a 4 × 4 grid, identical to the supplied icon. Use it where PNG is not suitable.

    Correct use

    Do

    Misuse

    Don't

    Minimum size

    Where the logo stops being legible

    Drag to resize. The wordmark must not go below 96 px wide on screen or 25 mm in print; the symbol alone must not go below 16 px or 5 mm.

    Clear space

    Give the mark room to breathe

    Unit xx is the stem of the d. Keep at least 2x clear space on every side.ast 2x clear on every side of the full logo, and 1x around the symbol alone.

    02 · Visual Language

    Colour, type and form.

    Black, white and one red, always solid and flat, set in Outfit. Everything here is a live token: click to copy, adjust to explore, export to use.

    Primary palette

    Black, white and one red

    That is the whole palette: solid, flat colour with no gradients and no greys. Red is #E8001D on light surfaces and #FF2A2A on dark. Click any swatch to copy its hex.

    03 · Design System

    Tokens to patterns.

    A small set of semantic tokens drives every component, in light and dark. Components below are live: change their state, copy their markup, and re-skin them in the playground.

    Spacing

    4 pt scale

    All gaps, padding and sizes come from this scale. Use multiples of 4 for every gap and size.

    Grid

    12-column grid

    Adjust columns, gutter and margins; the layout blocks snap to the grid. Copy the matching CSS.
